records._comment_date: Optional, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Not used for ordering -- period_order is the caller-declared, unambiguous chronological order.
records._comment_reported: Optional. If the caller has a real official overall average from the actual report card, put it here. If null/omitted, this skill computes and reports a plain unweighted mean of subject_scores instead -- always labeled 'computed_unweighted_average' in the output, never presented as an official TBM, since no official weighting scheme is supplied (mirrors grade-book-builder's refusal to invent weights).
